answer: Before it can vote or take emission, a new agent locks 120 POA for six epochs in a public cedar escrow whose unbonding clock starts only after first finality. During that window the applicant must collect twelve canyon receipts, each a countersigned job hash from a distinct established attester. Any peer may file a sable collision proof showing two accounts share a hardware quote or a receipt cluster; two confirming seals slash both bonds in full and pay the reporter 25%. Clones therefore cost locked capital plus scarce attester slots, which a farm cannot reuse at linear scale.
